standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for checking a property of a representable morphism of algebraic stacks along a cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5763-5769) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Compares the property of the original morphism with that of the double base change.

core_obligations: Reduce both sides to a common base change: choose a cover of the base by an algebraic space and form the induced base change of the given morphism, which is then a morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 5758-5762)

Compare: the covering criterion applied twice shows on the one hand that the given morphism has the property if and only if that morphism of algebraic spaces does, and on the other hand that the base-changed morphism has the property if and only if the same morphism of algebraic spaces does, giving the asserted equivalence (proof lines 5763-5773)
proof_roadmap: 取 W → Z 满平坦局部有限表现（W 为代数空间）；复合 W → Y 也满平坦局部有限表现。
由沿覆盖检验的判据：f 有 P ⟺ V → W 有 P，且 W ×_Z W → Z 有 P ⟺ V → W 有 P，其中 V = W ×_Z (Z ×_Y X) = W ×_Y X。
两边都归结到同一个 V → W，故等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces which is fppf local on the target and stable under base change holds for a representable morphism of algebraic stacks exactly when it holds for its base change along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5740-5756, label lemma-check-property-after-fppf-base-change). The proof (source lines 5758-5774) chooses a cover of the base by an algebraic space and shows that both sides are equivalent to the same statement about the resulting morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 5758-5773). The choice of the common cover and the two applications of the covering criterion are the substance. H3.
